questions.text: The diff only changes the constant. The comparison logic in app/pricing/** is not shown. Is 'at or above' (>=) applied to the subtotal, so exactly 75.00 ships free?
Is the threshold compared against the subtotal before or after discounts, promo codes and taxes? The spec only says 'order' and 'subtotal'.
Does the receipt read the shipping value from the same pricing code as api.quote_order, or does it have its own copy of the threshold (for example in a template or front-end code)?
Does the threshold apply to all customer types (guest, returning, wholesale, staff), or do some have different shipping rules?
Is the $50 threshold hard-coded anywhere else (docs, banners, UI text such as 'Free shipping over $50', tests, other config)? The spec scope lists only app/config.py and app/pricing/**.
What happens with a subtotal of 0, an empty cart, or a cart containing the TEST-SKU custom price? Is shipping still $5.99 or is it handled differently?
How is the subtotal rounded before comparison, for example 74.995 or fractional cents from custom prices? The spec only gives two-decimal values.

proposed_scenarios.why: Exact boundary, at the new threshold.
One cent below the new threshold.
The old threshold must no longer give free shipping.
Just above the boundary, to check there is no off-by-one on the free side.
Negative or degenerate case: the zero subtotal behaviour is not defined by the spec.
